title: Spatiotemporal co-transcriptomics uncovers coordinated rhizobia-legume stress programs supporting nitrogen fixation in Medicago
title_zh: 时空共转录组学揭示共调节的根瘤菌-豆科植物应激程序，支持Medicago中的氮固定
abstract: Rhizobial nitrogen fixation in legume nodules requires precise spatial and temporal coordination between host and bacterial gene expression. Here, we applied spatial enhanced resolution omics sequencing (Stereo-seq) to profile Medicago nodules across five developmental stages, generating a co-transcriptomic atlas of nodule development. Using a mixed-probe capture strategy, we simultaneously detected host and rhizobial transcripts within the same tissue sections, enabling analysis of host-microbe transcriptional coordination during symbiosis. We identified dynamic changes in host cell composition and developmental trajectories and uncovered two transcription factors, MtERF82 and MtDOF53, required for maintenance of the indeterminate nodule meristem. Rhizobial and host genes exhibited stage- and zone-specific expression patterns along the nodule apex-to-base axis. Notably, reactive oxygen species (ROS)-associated stress responses in both host cells and rhizobia were linked to symbiotic nitrogen fixation. Functional analyses further showed that MtERF71 and MtCBF1 promote nitrogen fixation by regulating ROS homeostasis and activating key symbiotic genes, highlighting stress signaling as an integral component of mutualistic symbiosis.
abstract_zh: 根瘤菌在豆科植物根瘤中的氮固定需要宿主与细菌基因表达之间的精确时空协调。本文利用空间增强分辨率组学测序（Stereo-seq）对Medicago根瘤在五个发育阶段进行剖面分析，构建了根瘤发育的共转录组图谱。通过混合探针捕获策略，我们在同一组织切片中同时检测到宿主与根瘤菌的转录本，从而实现了共生期间宿主-微生物转录协调的分析。研究发现宿主细胞组成和发育轨迹的动态变化，并鉴定出两种转录因子 MtERF82 和 MtDOF53，它们对不确定根瘤分生组织的维持至关重要。根瘤菌与宿主基因在根瘤顶端至基部轴向呈现阶段和区段特异性的表达模式。值得注意的是，宿主细胞与根瘤菌中的活性氧（ROS）相关应激反应与共生氮固定相关联。功能分析进一步表明，MtERF71 和 MtCBF1 通过调节 ROS 维持和激活关键共生基因，促进氮固定，突显应激信号是互惠共生的重要组成部分。
